objective: Persist project attachment deletion intent with the project transaction and perform object cleanup asynchronously with retry and recovery.

requirements.statement: Project deletion must enqueue all project attachment cleanup intents and soft-delete metadata without invoking object storage.
acceptance: no storage deletion occurs in project deletion path
counterexample: project deletion loops over synchronous AttachmentPort.delete

requirements.statement: A post-commit worker must mark successful object deletion DONE and persist a retryable failure state.
acceptance: failure test writes RETRY and increments attempts

requirements.statement: Outbox registration and processing must avoid duplicate active work and reclaim expired leases.
counterexample: same attachment has two pending events

requirements.statement: Existing project authorization, audit and related data cleanup remain unchanged.
The Outbox schema is append-only and pending events survive an application rollback.

invariants: No storage credentials or contents in Outbox
no network delete inside project transaction
tenant and attachment IDs on every event

assumptions.text: storage delete may be retried for one object key.
assumptions.basis: existing attachment cleanup service retries failure
assumptions.falsifier: storage adapter reports absent object as unrecoverable.

decisions.question: How to recover after process loss

measurement_intents.observable: project service invokes enqueue rather than storage deletion
unique event and lease reclaim SQL
